The '''tome of earth''' is a book held in place of a [[shield]] that is a possible reward from [[the Hueycoatl]]. The tome of earth requires level 50 in [[Magic]] to wield.

The tome is only tradeable when empty. When it is empty, its only function is its magic attack and magic defence equipment bonuses.

Empty tomes can be traded in for 250 [[soiled page]]s per tome (value of {{Coins|{{GEP|Soiled page|250}}}}) by speaking to the [[Seer (The Darkfrost)|seer]] at [[the Darkfrost]].

==Charging==
The tome can be charged with [[soiled page]]s. Each page provides 20 charges, and the tome can hold up to 1,000 pages. Players can configure the amount of charges on withdrawal by right-clicking the tome while the tome is in the bank and selecting Configure-Charges.

Charging the tome with [[soiled page]]s costs {{Coins|{{GEP|Soiled page|1000}}}} to fully charge, for an effective cost of {{Coins|{{GEP|Soiled page|0.05}}}} per charge.

Pages can be removed from the tome, but if one or more charges are used from a page, '''the page will be entirely consumed upon removal.'''

==Effects==
A charged tome of earth provides the following benefits:

* Casting an offensive [[earth spell]] from the [[standard spellbook]] with a charged tome equipped will increase the spell's damage by 10% against NPCs (stacking multiplicatively with Magic damage bonuses), and consumes one charge per cast.
* Will act as an infinite source of earth runes for all spells, and will not consume charges when using this effect to cast non-combat spells.
